title: Takoyaki Flip Stall
tagline: Pour, fill and flip golden street-stall balls for a queue of hungry customers.
description: Run a street stall in Japan: pour batter into the iron plate, add fillings, flip each ball a quarter turn at the right moment and pack it for the right ticket. Three stalls, Rush Hour, a Daily Shift and Watch and Learn. Portrait or landscape.
howToPlay: Pick the ladle and hold or drag over moulds to pour batter.
Choose a filling and sweep it over fresh batter.
Take the picks and tap a ball while its ring is green to flip it a quarter turn.
After four golden quarters the ball glows: tap it to pack it for a ticket.
Keep every customer happy; three lost customers close the stall.
